 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Matchday 5 of the UEFA Nations League will be played today in League B in Group 4. Sweden are top of Group 4 and will face second-place Bosnia and Herzegovina.
 Both teams are unbeaten in this group after four matches played, with Sweden sitting first with 10 points while Bosnia and Herzegovina is second with 8 points. A win for Sweden will see them promoted to League A.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Bosnia and Herzegovina would top the group if they beat Sweden and have the edge of also securing promotion themselves with a game in hand.
 In matchday 3 of this group in the UEFA Nations League, Bosnia and Herzegovina hosted Sweden at home and the game finished in a 1-1 draw. Viktor Gyökeres gave Sweden the lead, but then Kerim Alajbegovic scored the equalizer for Bosnia and Herzegovina.
 In the previous matchday, both teams won their matches. Sweden defeated Romania 1-0 away from home with a goal from Gyokeres, while Bosnia and Herzegovina defeated Poland 1-0 at home with a penalty goal by Ivan Basic.

 Official Lineups for Sweden and Bosnia and Herzegovina 
 Sweden 
 Goalkeeper: Viktor Johansson
 Defenders: Daniel Svensson, Victor Nilsson Lindelof, Gustaf Lagerbielke, Gabriel Gudmundsson
 Midfielders: Sebastian Nanasi, Yasin Ayari, Hugo Larsson, Anthony Elanga
 Forwards: Viktor Gyökeres, Alexander Isak
 Bosnia and Herzegovina 
 Goalkeeper: Martin Zlomislic
 Defenders: Sead Kolasinac, Nikola Katic, Stjepan Radeljic
 Midfielders: Kerim Alajbegovic, Ivan Basic, Ermedin Demirovic, Armin Gigovic, Amar Dedic
 Forwards: Haris Tabakovic, Esmir Bajraktarevic
 Where to Watch Sweden vs. Bosnia and Herzegovina – UEFA Nations League – League B Group 4
 Sweden vs. Bosnia and Herzegovina kicks off at 2:45 P.M. ET / 11:45 A.M. PT in the United States. The match will kick off at 8:45 P.M. local time at Strawberry Arena in Solna, Sweden.
 The match will be available to watch in the United States and in other countries through select TV channels and streaming services.
